verdict.rationale: PayPal explicitly documents OpenAPI specs: 'Explore our REST API descriptions, generate code for your API clients, and import OpenAPI documents into compatible third-party tools' (paypal-docs-54), backed by a dedicated public GitHub repo of OpenAPI JSON files (paypal-docs-16, e.g. checkout_orders_v2.json) usable for codegen. This is corroborated by a live probe confirming machine-readable docs infrastructure (llms.txt, markdown docs) exists and is publicly accessible. missing for 10: no independent third-party confirmation of spec completeness/versioning or a single consolidated top-level OpenAPI file link beyond the GitHub repo.
